SHAMOJI is Japanese style tavern to enjoy delicious food and Japanese sake.We're open lunch time from 12:00am~14:00pm.(Dinner. 18:00~23:00)
If you came to Hakone-machi,Sengokuhara. Please by all means, come to SHAMOJI.
